neighbours.label: daring: taking a risk, experimenting or 'going for it' as a bold choice; 'risk' as a hazard and 'experiment' as a lab study stay quiet
fire: The young chef was willing to take risks with unusual flavours.
Her coach told her to be brave and go for the difficult jump.
In the studio the band felt free to experiment with strange sounds.
He is a striker who takes chances and shoots from anywhere.
Good designers are not afraid to take a risk on a wild idea.
She decided to gamble and try a completely new style.
The director encouraged the actors to take chances in every scene.
Nobody succeeds in this business without daring to take risks.
quiet: The young chef was careful to follow recipes with familiar flavours.
Her coach told her to stay calm and skip the difficult jump.
In the laboratory the team ran an experiment with sound waves.
He is a defender who stays back and passes to the wing.
Good inspectors assess the risk of fire in every building.
She decided to wait and keep her usual style.
The director reminded the actors to learn their lines for every scene.
Smoking raises the risk of heart disease in adults.

notes: Probes: 'afraid to take a risk' 0.62, 'free to experiment' 0.61, 'takes chances and goes for it' 0.55; 'The risk of fire' 0.04, 'ran an experiment on mice' 0.01, 'The font is bold' 0.00; 'afraid to take a nap' 0.25 and 'a bold move' only 0.18, so the frame 'afraid/free to …' carries part of it.
